arxiv-2204-07713.description: Abstract In recent hyperspectral unmixing (HU) literature, the application of deep learning (DL) has become more prominent, especially with the autoencoder (AE) architecture. We propose a split architecture and use a pseudo-ground truth for abundances to guide the ‘unmixing network’ (UN) optimization.

arxiv-2303-02565.title: Indirect Exchange Interaction Leads to Large Lattice Contribution to Magnetocaloric Entropy Change
arxiv-2303-02565.creator: Lokanath Patra, Bolin Liao
arxiv-2303-02565.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Lokanath Patra, Bolin Liao. Materials with a large magnetocaloric response are highly desirable for magnetic cooling applications. It is suggested that a strong spin-lattice coupling tends to generate a large magnetocaloric effect, but no microscopic mechanism has been proposed. In this work, we use spin-lattice dynamics simulation to examine the lattice contribution to the magnetocaloric entropy change in bcc iron (Fe) and hcp gadolinium (Gd) with exchange interaction parameters determined from ab-initio calculations.

arxiv-2303-12843.title: de Sitter State in Heterotic String Theory
arxiv-2303-12843.creator: Stephon Alexander 1 , Keshav Dasgupta 2 , Archana Maji 3 , P. Ramadevi 3 and Radu Tatar 4 1 Brown Theoretical Physics Center and Department of Physics, Brown University, Providence, RI 02912, USA 2 Department of Physics, McGill University, Montréal, Québec, H3A 2T8, Canada 3 Department of Physics, I
arxiv-2303-12843.description: Abstract Recent no-go theorems have ruled out four-dimensional classical de Sitter vacua in heterotic string theory. On the other hand, the absence of a well-defined Wilsonian effective action and other related phenomena also appear to rule out such time-dependent vacua with de Sitter isometries, even in the presence of quantum corrections.

arxiv-2307-12814.description: Abstract Stimulated Brillouin scattering (SBS), a coherent nonlinear effect coupling acoustics and optics, can be used in a wide range of applications such as Brillouin lasers and tunable narrowband RF filtering. Wide adoption of such technologies however, would need a balance of strong Brillouin interaction and low optical loss in a structure compatible with large scale fabrication.

arxiv-2505-23519.title: Individual differences in the cognitive mechanisms of planning strategy discovery
arxiv-2505-23519.creator: Ruiqi He, Falk Lieder
arxiv-2505-23519.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ruiqi He, Falk Lieder. People employ efficient planning strategies. But how are these strategies acquired? Previous research suggests that people can discover new planning strategies through learning from reinforcements, a process known as metacognitive reinforcement learning (MCRL). While prior work has shown that MCRL models can learn new planning strategies and explain more participants’ experience-driven discovery better than alternative mechanisms, it also revealed significant individual differences in metacognitive learning.

arxiv-2506-00784.title: Research Borderlands: Analysing Writing Across Research Cultures
arxiv-2506-00784.creator: Shaily Bhatt shaily@cmu.edu, Tal August tagust@illinois.edu, Maria Antoniak maria.antoniak@colorado.edu
arxiv-2506-00784.description: Abstract Improving cultural competence of language technologies is important. However most recent works rarely engage with the communities they study, and instead rely on synthetic setups and imperfect proxies of culture. In this work, we take a human-centered approach to discover and measure language-based cultural norms, and cultural competence of LLMs.

arxiv-2510-18182.title: Electron Acceleration via Lower-Hybrid Drift Instability in Astrophysical Plasmas: Dependence on Plasma Beta and Suprathermal Electron Distributions
arxiv-2510-18182.creator: Ji-Hoon, Elena S
arxiv-2510-18182.description: Abstract Аннотация Density inhomogeneities are ubiquitous in space and astrophysical plasmas, particularly at magnetic reconnection sites, shock fronts, and within compressible turbulence. The gradients associated with these inhomogeneous plasma regions serve as free energy sources that can drive plasma instabilities, including the lower-hybrid drift instability (LHDI).

arxiv-2512-10474.description: Abstract Context. Recent space missions such as CoRoT, Kepler , and TESS have made asteroseismology a powerful tool for studying the internal structure of stars.
